02 / Approach

Precision in every pixel.

My approach combines visual judgment with a quality-assurance mindset. I pay attention to edges, texture, lighting consistency, artifacts and the small details that make an image feel believable.

I also bring experience in image annotation and evaluation workflows, where consistency, guideline adherence and careful review matter as much as speed.
